text:
```yaml
name: Build Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  build-and-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install Node.js dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run npm build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: mbstring, intl, gd, exif, iconv, xml, zip

      - name: Install PHP production dependencies
        run: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --prefer-dist --no-interaction

      - name: Create .distignore file
        run: echo "node_modules\ndist\nvendor\ntests\ndocs" > .distignore

      - name: Create distribution zip
        run: |
          mkdir dist
          rsync -av --exclude-from=.distignore . dist/
          cd dist
          zip -r ../plugin.zip .

      - name: Upload release asset
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./dist/plugin.zip
          asset_name: pressforward-plugin-${{ github.ref_name }}.zip
          asset_content_type: application/zip
```
